Title: Launch - Force-quit and reopen reaches the main menu
Step: If Spider is already open, swipe it away from the app switcher, then tap the Spider icon.
Expected Result: The app opens.

Title: Launch - Force-quit and reopen reaches the main menu
Step: If Terms & Conditions or the tracking prompt appear, dismiss them (Continue, then Allow).
Expected Result: No pop-up is left on screen.

Title: Launch - Force-quit and reopen reaches the main menu
Step: Wait until the menu finishes appearing.
Expected Result: You can see Play and the rest of the main menu.

Title: Launch - Fresh install shows Terms & Conditions
Step: Delete Spider and reinstall it, or otherwise reset it so it has never agreed to the terms. Open the app.
Expected Result: A Terms & Conditions card appears.

Title: Launch - Fresh install shows Terms & Conditions
Step: Tap Continue.
Expected Result: The card goes away. The iOS tracking prompt may appear next.

Title: Launch - Fresh install shows the tracking prompt
Step: After Terms & Conditions, wait for the iOS tracking prompt (Allow / Ask App Not to Track).
Expected Result: The system tracking alert is on screen.

Title: Launch - Fresh install shows the tracking prompt
Step: Tap Allow. Do not tap Ask App Not to Track — that does not clear the gate.
Expected Result: The prompt goes away and you can reach the main menu.

Title: Launch - Terms & Conditions link opens the terms page
Step: Delete Spider and reinstall it, or otherwise reset it so the Terms & Conditions card is on screen. Do not tap Continue yet.
Expected Result: The card shows links for Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy.

Title: Launch - Terms & Conditions link opens the terms page
Step: Tap the Terms & Conditions link.
Expected Result: A terms web page opens, not the Privacy Policy page.

Title: Launch - Terms & Conditions link opens the terms page
Step: If Accept All Cookies appears, tap it and wait for the cookie banner to disappear.
Expected Result: The banner is gone and the Terms of Service heading is fully visible.

Title: Launch - Terms & Conditions link opens the terms page
Step: Close the page or tap Back.
Expected Result: The Terms & Conditions card is still there. Do not tap Continue yet.

Title: Launch - Privacy Policy link opens the privacy page
Step: On the same Terms & Conditions card, tap Privacy Policy.
Expected Result: A privacy web page opens, not the Terms & Conditions page.

Title: Launch - Privacy Policy link opens the privacy page
Step: If Accept All Cookies appears, tap it and wait for the cookie banner to disappear.
Expected Result: The banner is gone and the Privacy Notice heading is fully visible.

Title: Launch - Privacy Policy link opens the privacy page
Step: Close the page or tap Back.
Expected Result: The Terms & Conditions card is still there. Continue is checked separately in FL-02.

Title: Launch - Latest odd TestFlight build installs
Step: Open TestFlight and tap Spider / Spider Solitaire.
Expected Result: The TestFlight page for this game is showing.

Title: Launch - Latest odd TestFlight build installs
Step: Scroll to Previous Builds and tap it. Tap the top row.
Expected Result: The newest build's page is showing.

Title: Launch - Latest odd TestFlight build installs
Step: If that page's version in parentheses is odd, delete Spider if it is installed, then tap Install and wait. If it is even, stop.
Expected Result: The odd build installs. An even newest build leaves the existing Spider installation unchanged.

Title: Main Menu - All eight controls are visible
Step: Open the app and wait until the menu finishes animating (a Game Center toast or sparkle can hide a label for a moment).
Expected Result: Play, Stats, Options, Help, About, More Games, Choose Look, and the Spider logo are all on screen.

Title: Statistics - Opens from the main menu
Step: From the main menu, tap Stats.
Expected Result: The Statistics screen opens. The header reads Statistics. The main menu is gone.

Title: Statistics - Page scrolls down to Reset Statistics
Step: From the main menu, tap Stats.
Expected Result: The Statistics screen opens. Game Center is in the header.

Title: Statistics - Page scrolls down to Reset Statistics
Step: Scroll the page all the way down. Do not tap Reset.
Expected Result: Reset Statistics is at the bottom. If you cannot reach it, the lower difficulty blocks did not render.

Title: Statistics - Back returns to the main menu
Step: From Statistics, tap Back.
Expected Result: The main menu is showing.

Title: Options - Opens from the main menu
Step: From the main menu, tap Options.
Expected Result: The Options screen opens. The main menu is gone.

Title: Options - Applause Volume moves to min, max, and middle
Step: From the main menu, tap Options and find Applause Volume.
Expected Result: A slider with a knob is on the row. The - and + marks are labels, not buttons.

Title: Options - Applause Volume moves to min, max, and middle
Step: Drag the knob all the way left, all the way right, then to the middle.
Expected Result: The knob sits at the left end, then the right end, then somewhere in the middle — not only at the two ends.

Title: Options - Applause Volume stays after you leave the screen
Step: On Options, drag Applause Volume to a new position and remember where the knob sits.
Expected Result: The knob moves.

Title: Options - Applause Volume stays after you leave the screen
Step: Go back to the main menu, then open Options again.
Expected Result: The knob is still where you left it.

Title: Options - Auto Mute Sounds turns off and on
Step: Open Options and look at Auto Mute Sounds (it ships ON).
Expected Result: You can tell whether the toggle is on or off.

Title: Options - Auto Mute Sounds turns off and on
Step: Tap the toggle, then tap it again.
Expected Result: It flips the first time and returns the second time. A tap that does nothing fails.

Title: Options - Card Lowering moves to min, max, and middle
Step: Open Options, scroll to Card Lowering, and drag the knob all the way left, all the way right, then to the middle.
Expected Result: The knob reaches both ends and can sit in the middle. It is not a stepped control that only snaps to the ends.

Title: Options - Use Hearts turns on and off
Step: Open Options, scroll to Use Hearts (it ships OFF), and tap the toggle twice.
Expected Result: It turns on, then back off.

Title: Help - Opens on Introduction
Step: From the main menu, tap Help.
Expected Result: Help opens with the Introduction heading. The main menu is gone.

Title: Help - Rules scroll down to the FAQ link
Step: From the main menu, tap Help.
Expected Result: Help opens on Introduction.

Title: Help - Rules scroll down to the FAQ link
Step: Scroll the rules text down.
Expected Result: A frequently asked questions link appears at the bottom. A header with an empty body fails.

Title: Help - Back returns to the main menu
Step: From Help, tap Back.
Expected Result: The main menu is showing.

Title: About - Opens from the About menu item
Step: From the main menu, tap About.
Expected Result: The About screen opens. You can see the copyright line.

Title: About - Version and links are on the page
Step: From the main menu, tap About.
Expected Result: About opens with a version line, copyright, and links for Help, frequently asked questions, and submit feedback. Do not tap ad free version or submit feedback here — they leave the app.

Title: About - Frequently asked questions stays in the app
Step: On About, tap frequently asked questions.
Expected Result: An FAQ screen opens inside Spider. You do not leave for a browser or the App Store.

Title: About - FAQ scrolls down to submit feedback
Step: Open FAQ from About. The first screen ends mid-answer. Scroll down.
Expected Result: Submit feedback appears at the bottom. The FAQ title at the top stays put; you are still on FAQ.

Title: About - Spider logo also opens About
Step: From the main menu, tap the Spider logo at the top.
Expected Result: About opens, the same screen as the About menu item.

Title: More Games - Gift icon opens the in-app promo page
Step: From the main menu, tap More Games (the gift icon).
Expected Result: An in-app page opens with Tap any game to download it! You do not jump to the App Store.

Title: More Games - Swipe reveals FreeCell and Spiderette
Step: On the More Games page, swipe the list of games up once.
Expected Result: FreeCell and Spiderette come into view. The back button and instruction line at the top stay put.

Title: More Games - Back returns to the main menu
Step: From the More Games page, tap Back.
Expected Result: The main menu is showing.

Title: Play - Opens the difficulty picker
Step: From the main menu, tap Play.
Expected Result: A difficulty picker opens. A game does not start yet.

Title: Play - Picker shows all five levels
Step: Open Play.
Expected Result: Easy, Medium, Hard, Bold, and Expert are all listed.

Title: Play - Easy starts a game
Step: On the picker, tap Easy. If the app asks whether to abandon a paused game, tap Yes.
Expected Result: You are on the game table (cards and the in-game bar). A prompt that only closed the picker is not enough.

Title: Play - Declining abandon stays on the picker
Step: With a paused game, open Play and tap its difficulty again.
Expected Result: An abandon confirmation appears.

Title: Play - Declining abandon stays on the picker
Step: Tap No.
Expected Result: The new deal is cancelled. The difficulty picker remains open, the game table has not started, and the paused game has not been discarded.

Title: QA - Dev Panel is hidden until you unlock it
Section Hierarchy: Spider Solitaire Unity > QA / Dev Panel
Step: Open About. If a Dev Panel button is already in the bottom-right, tap the spider emblem (the spider above the wordmark, not the words) five times quickly to hide it.
Expected Result: No Dev Panel button is showing. A build that always shows the button fails.

Title: QA - Five quick taps on the emblem show Dev Panel
Section Hierarchy: Spider Solitaire Unity > QA / Dev Panel
Step: On About, tap the spider emblem five times quickly. Tap the emblem, not the Spider SOLITAIRE wordmark under it.
Expected Result: A Dev Panel button appears in the bottom-right corner.

Title: QA - Five more taps hide Dev Panel again
Section Hierarchy: Spider Solitaire Unity > QA / Dev Panel
Step: With the Dev Panel button showing on About, tap the emblem five times quickly again.
Expected Result: The Dev Panel button disappears. The gesture turns it on and off.

Title: Gameplay - Table controls are on screen
Step: Start or resume an Easy game.
Expected Result: You can see Back, the in-game menu, tap to undo, tap to lower, and tap for hints.

Title: Gameplay - Dealing from the stock changes the board
Step: On a table that still has cards in the stock, look at the tableau, then tap the stock pile.
Expected Result: The board changes (new cards appear). A tap that does nothing fails.

Title: Gameplay - Undo puts the board back
Step: After a stock deal that changed the board, tap tap to undo.
Expected Result: The board looks like it did before the deal. Undo must restore the cards, not only play an animation.

Title: Gameplay - Tap to lower drops the playfield
Step: If the table is already shifted down, tap tap to lower once to raise it first (this setting survives leaving a game).
Expected Result: The top bar sits in its normal (raised) place.

Title: Gameplay - Tap to lower drops the playfield
Step: Tap tap to lower once.
Expected Result: The whole playfield slides down, including the top bar.

Title: Gameplay - Tap to raise brings the playfield back
Step: With the playfield lowered, tap tap to lower again (same control).
Expected Result: The playfield slides back up to where it started.

Title: Gameplay - Tap for hints highlights a move
Step: On a table that has a legal move, tap tap for hints. Watch the board as you tap — the highlight lasts less than a second.
Expected Result: A move is highlighted briefly. If you look away and look back, the board may look unchanged; that is expected.

Title: Gameplay - In-game menu shows all six actions
Step: On the table, open the in-game menu.
Expected Result: You see Replay, Abandon, Options, New, Help, and FAQ. Do not tap Abandon — it ends the game.

Title: Gameplay - Use Hearts ON turns Easy cards into hearts
Step: Start Easy. The cards should be black spades. If they are already hearts, open Options and turn Use Hearts off first.
Expected Result: The dealt cards are black spades.

Title: Gameplay - Use Hearts ON turns Easy cards into hearts
Step: Open the in-game menu, tap Options, turn Use Hearts on, and go back to the table.
Expected Result: The same deal is now red hearts. Easy only — Medium already mixes suits.

Title: Gameplay - Use Hearts OFF turns the cards back to spades
Step: With Use Hearts on and hearts on the Easy table, open Options, turn Use Hearts off, and go back to the table.
Expected Result: The cards are black spades again.

Title: Gameplay - Rich Features OFF hides timer, score, multiplier
Step: On the table, look under the cards for the timer, score, and multiplier.
Expected Result: Those three items are visible.

Title: Gameplay - Rich Features OFF hides timer, score, multiplier
Step: Open the in-game menu, tap Options, turn Rich Features off, and go back to the table.
Expected Result: Timer, score, and multiplier are gone.

Title: Gameplay - Rich Features ON brings timer, score, multiplier back
Step: With Rich Features off, open Options, turn Rich Features on, and go back to the table.
Expected Result: Timer, score, and multiplier are visible again. Turn this back on before you leave — tap to lower also disappears while it is off.

Title: Gameplay - New deals a different board
Step: Look at the current board, open the in-game menu, and tap New. If a tip card appears, tap OK.
Expected Result: You are still on a game table, and the cards are a different deal.

Title: Victory - Complete Game from the table shows the win screen
Step: Unlock Dev Panel on About if needed (five quick taps on the spider emblem). Deal Easy. Open Dev Panel on the table and tap Complete Game. Do not fire Complete Game from About — it only works on a game that is already open.
Expected Result: The Victory screen appears.

Title: Victory - Complete Game from the table shows the win screen
Step: Close the Dev Panel so it is not covering the right side.
Expected Result: The Victory buttons on the right are visible.

Title: Victory - Win screen shows all of its parts
Step: On the Victory screen, with Dev Panel closed, look over the page.
Expected Result: You can see the ranking-for header, current / rank / best columns, leaderboards, achievements, help, new, and stats.

Title: Victory - Footer names the level you just played
Step: Win an Easy game with Complete Game and read the footer.
Expected Result: It says Easy level, matching the game you started, not some other level.

Title: Victory - Back returns to the main menu
Step: On Victory, tap the screen's own Back control — not New.
Expected Result: The main menu is showing. Leaving by Back leaves no game in progress.

Title: Difficulty - Medium starts and can be completed
Step: From the menu, tap Play, then Medium.
Expected Result: A Medium game is on the table.

Title: Difficulty - Medium starts and can be completed
Step: Open Dev Panel on the table, tap Complete Game, close the panel, then tap Back on Victory.
Expected Result: Victory appeared for Medium, then you can get back to the menu.

Title: Difficulty - Hard starts and can be completed
Step: From the menu, tap Play, then Hard. Complete the game from Dev Panel on the table, then tap Back on Victory.
Expected Result: Hard dealt a table, Victory appeared, and you can get back to the menu.

Title: Difficulty - Bold starts and can be completed
Step: From the menu, tap Play, then Bold. Complete the game from Dev Panel on the table, then tap Back on Victory.
Expected Result: Bold dealt a table, Victory appeared, and you can get back to the menu.

Title: Difficulty - Expert starts and can be completed
Step: From the menu, tap Play, then Expert. Complete the game from Dev Panel on the table, then tap Back on Victory.
Expected Result: Expert dealt a table, Victory appeared, and you can get back to the menu.

Title: Promo icons - Five game icons on the menu after a win
Step: Finish at least one game (or use Complete Game), then go to the main menu. Wait a few seconds.
Expected Result: Five icons sit on the left: Solitaire, Sudoku 2, Card Games, FreeCell, and Spiderette. A fresh install with no wins does not show this strip — that is normal.

Title: Promo icons - Solitaire opens Solitaire: Classic Cards
Step: On the menu, tap the Solitaire icon. Wi-Fi must be on.
Expected Result: The App Store opens.

Title: Promo icons - Solitaire opens Solitaire: Classic Cards
Step: Read the store page name.
Expected Result: The page is Solitaire: Classic Cards.

Title: Promo icons - Solitaire opens Solitaire: Classic Cards
Step: Tap ◀ Spider in the status bar (or switch back to Spider).
Expected Result: You are back on the main menu. Spider did not restart.

Title: Promo icons - Sudoku 2 opens Sudoku
Step: Tap the Sudoku 2 icon.
Expected Result: The App Store opens on a Sudoku page.

Title: Promo icons - Sudoku 2 opens Sudoku
Step: Switch back to Spider.
Expected Result: The main menu is showing.

Title: Promo icons - Card Games opens Card Games
Step: Tap the Card Games icon.
Expected Result: The App Store opens on Card Games — not another Solitaire or card title.

Title: Promo icons - Card Games opens Card Games
Step: Switch back to Spider.
Expected Result: The main menu is showing.

Title: Promo icons - FreeCell opens FreeCell
Step: Tap the FreeCell icon.
Expected Result: The App Store opens on FreeCell.

Title: Promo icons - FreeCell opens FreeCell
Step: Switch back to Spider.
Expected Result: The main menu is showing.

Title: Promo icons - Spiderette opens Spiderette
Step: Tap the Spiderette icon.
Expected Result: The App Store opens on Spiderette.

Title: Promo icons - Spiderette opens Spiderette
Step: Switch back to Spider.
Expected Result: The main menu is showing.

Title: Reset Statistics - Link asks you to confirm
Step: Open Stats, scroll to Reset Statistics, and tap it.
Expected Result: A confirmation appears (reset local scores?). Game Center scores are not part of this wipe.

Title: Reset Statistics - Confirming wipes local scores
Step: Accept every confirmation. The app asks twice (a second just to be on the safe side).
Expected Result: Local statistics are cleared. You can get back to the menu. Do this last — it wipes play history on the device.

Title: Reset Statistics - Declining leaves scores alone
Step: Open Stats, scroll to Reset Statistics, and tap it.
Expected Result: A reset confirmation appears.

Title: Reset Statistics - Declining leaves scores alone
Step: Tap No.
Expected Result: The confirmation closes, Statistics remains open, and the local scores are unchanged.

Title: Choose Look - Opens on the Surface tab
Step: From the main menu, tap Choose Look. If Cards is showing, tap Surface.
Expected Result: The look picker opens. Surface content (Simulate Depth) is showing.

Title: Choose Look - Surface and Cards tabs switch
Step: In Choose Look, tap Cards, then tap Surface again.
Expected Result: Cards shows Extra Large Card-Symbols. Surface comes back to Simulate Depth.

Title: Choose Look - Sixth surface shows on the game table
Step: On Surface, tap the 6th palette (second row, third column — light checkered wood).
Expected Result: That palette is selected.

Title: Choose Look - Sixth surface shows on the game table
Step: Close Choose Look, start or resume Easy, and look at the felt.
Expected Result: The table felt matches the palette you picked, not only the thumbnail in the picker.

Title: Choose Look - Fifth card back shows on the table
Step: On Cards, tap the 5th palette (second row, second column — black filigree).
Expected Result: That deck is selected.

Title: Choose Look - Fifth card back shows on the table
Step: On the game table, look at the face-down card backs.
Expected Result: The backs match the deck you picked.

Title: Ads - Dev Panel opens (unlock if needed)
Step: Turn Wi-Fi on. Open Spider. If an old debugger or ad is still up, close it. If you are on the table, do not tap Back yet (that can fire an ad).
Expected Result: Spider is in front.

Title: Ads - Dev Panel opens (unlock if needed)
Step: If Dev Panel is already on screen, tap it. If not, go to About, tap the spider emblem five times quickly, then tap Dev Panel.
Expected Result: Dev Panel is open and shows Max Debugger.

Title: Ads - Max Debugger opens
Step: With Dev Panel open, tap Max Debugger.
Expected Result: MAX Mediation Debugger opens. You are still in Spider.

Title: Ads - Ads section shows the Live Network row
Step: In the debugger, scroll until you can tap the Ads row. It reads Select Live Network when empty, or Live Network when a network is already chosen.
Expected Result: That row is on screen and you can tap it.

Title: Ads - AppLovin is the live network
Step: Tap the Live Network row. Wait for the picker (its title is Select Live Network). AppLovin also appears higher up under Completed SDK Integrations — ignore that one.
Expected Result: The Select Live Network list is open.

Title: Ads - AppLovin is the live network
Step: If AppLovin is not already ticked, tap AppLovin.
Expected Result: A checkmark sits on AppLovin.

Title: Ads - Leave-game ad: close the store X, then the ad X
Step: Close the debugger (Done, then close Dev Panel). Start or resume a game. Wait about 30 seconds, then tap Back. If no ad appears, resume or deal again — that second enter is allowed.
Expected Result: A full-screen ad plays inside Spider. You did not leave for another app.

Title: Ads - Leave-game ad: close the store X, then the ad X
Step: First tap the App Store product sheet's X (if that sheet appears). Then tap the ad's own circular X. Do not tap the skip arrows that move around.
Expected Result: The store sheet closes first, then the ad.

Title: Ads - After the ad you are back on the table
Step: After both X buttons, wait for the game.
Expected Result: The game table is showing.

Title: Ads - Under 30s on the table, Options has no ad
Step: Start a game. Within about 8 seconds, open the in-game menu and tap Options. If an ad from an earlier session appears, close it, get back to the table, and try once more within 8 seconds.
Expected Result: Options opens with no ad.

Title: Ads - Over 30s on the table, Help shows an ad
Step: Stay on the table more than 30 seconds. Open the in-game menu and tap Help.
Expected Result: An ad plays. Close the store X, then the ad X.

Title: Ads - Options within 30s of the Help ad has no ad
Step: Right after you close the Help ad, go back to the table, open the in-game menu, and tap Options.
Expected Result: Options opens with no ad. The cooldown applies everywhere, not only on Victory.

Title: Ads - Over 30s on the table, Complete Game shows a Victory ad
Step: Stay on the table more than 30 seconds. Open Dev Panel and tap Complete Game.
Expected Result: Victory appears with an ad on top.

Title: Ads - Over 30s on the table, Complete Game shows a Victory ad
Step: Close the store X, then the ad X, then close Dev Panel.
Expected Result: The Victory screen is visible. Close the ad before the panel — the ad covers it.

Title: Ads - New within 30s of the Victory ad has no ad
Step: After closing the Victory ad, tap New within 30 seconds.
Expected Result: A new table deals with no ad.

Title: Ads - New after 30s on Victory shows an ad
Step: Win again with Complete Game after more than 30 seconds on the table. Close that Victory ad, stay on Victory more than 30 seconds, then tap New.
Expected Result: An ad plays before the next table. Close the store X, then the ad X.

Title: Ads - Over 30s on the table, Back shows an ad then the menu
Step: Stay on the table more than 30 seconds and tap Back.
Expected Result: An ad plays. After the store X and the ad X, you are on the main menu — not the table.

Title: Ads - Starting a game within 30s on the menu has no ad
Step: After the Back ad closed onto the menu, wait under 30 seconds and resume or deal a game.
Expected Result: The table appears with no ad.

Title: Ads - Starting a game after 30s on the menu shows an ad
Step: Leave a table with Back after more than 30 seconds, close that ad onto the menu, stay on the menu more than 30 seconds, then resume or deal.
Expected Result: An ad plays as you enter the game. This is the menu wait, not the same as the leave-game ad.

Title: Ads - Over 30s on the table, FAQ shows an ad
Step: Stay on the table more than 30 seconds. Open the in-game menu and tap FAQ.
Expected Result: An ad plays. After it closes you can get back to the table.

Title: Last Score - LAST SCORE opens Last Won Game Score
Step: From the menu, tap Play, then LAST SCORE. Wi-Fi should be on.
Expected Result: A ranking screen opens. The header reads Last Won Game Score.

Title: Last Score - Arrow cycles week, month, overall, day
Step: On Last Won Game Score, tap the forward arrow beside ranking for four times, about two seconds apart.
Expected Result: The period moves week → month → overall → day → week. You stay on Last Won Game Score — the arrow must not leave the screen.

Title: Last Score - Leaderboards opens Game Center
Step: On Last Score, tap leaderboards. You need a signed-in Apple ID.
Expected Result: Game Center opens, headed Leaderboards.

Title: Last Score - Leaderboards opens Game Center
Step: Tap Game Center's back arrow, then dismiss the sheet.
Expected Result: Last Score is showing again.

Title: Last Score - Achievements opens Game Center
Step: On Last Score, tap achievements.
Expected Result: Game Center opens, headed Achievements.

Title: Last Score - Achievements opens Game Center
Step: Tap back and dismiss the sheet.
Expected Result: Last Score is showing again.

Title: Last Score - Back returns to the main menu
Step: From Last Score, tap Back until you reach the menu.
Expected Result: The main menu is showing.

Title: Ad-free - No leaves you on About
Section Hierarchy: Spider Solitaire Unity > App Store / Mail
Step: On About, tap ad free version and tap No on the confirmation.
Expected Result: The card closes. Spider stays in front on About and the App Store does not open.

Title: Ad-free - Link asks No or Yes before the store
Section Hierarchy: Spider Solitaire Unity > App Store / Mail
Step: On About, tap ad free version.
Expected Result: A card asks if you want to look at the ad-free version (No on the left, Yes on the right). You are still in Spider.

Title: Ad-free - Yes opens Spider Solitaire +
Section Hierarchy: Spider Solitaire Unity > App Store / Mail
Step: On that card, tap Yes.
Expected Result: The App Store opens.

Title: Ad-free - Yes opens Spider Solitaire +
Section Hierarchy: Spider Solitaire Unity > App Store / Mail
Step: Read the store page name.
Expected Result: The page is Spider Solitaire +, the paid build of this game.

Title: Ad-free - Status-bar back lands on About
Section Hierarchy: Spider Solitaire Unity > App Store / Mail
Step: From the App Store, tap ◀ Spider in the status bar.
Expected Result: You are back on About. If you land on the main menu, the app restarted instead of resuming.

Title: Feedback - Submit feedback asks Cancel or Write Email
Section Hierarchy: Spider Solitaire Unity > App Store / Mail
Step: On About, tap submit feedback. A Mail account must be set up.
Expected Result: An alert offers Cancel and Write Email.

Title: Feedback - Write Email opens a Mail draft
Section Hierarchy: Spider Solitaire Unity > App Store / Mail
Step: Tap Write Email.
Expected Result: Mail opens with a draft. If you see No Mail Accounts, that is the phone setup, not the game.

Title: Feedback - Subject names the game, version, phone, and iOS
Section Hierarchy: Spider Solitaire Unity > App Store / Mail
Step: Read the draft subject. Compare it to Settings → General → About for the model and iOS version, and to About in the game for the version.
Expected Result: The subject names Spider, the app version, this phone's model, and this iOS version.

Title: Feedback - Delete the draft — do not send
Section Hierarchy: Spider Solitaire Unity > App Store / Mail
Step: Delete the draft. Do not tap send. Do this even if the subject was wrong.
Expected Result: The draft is gone. Nothing was sent.

Title: Feedback - Status-bar back returns to Spider
Section Hierarchy: Spider Solitaire Unity > App Store / Mail
Step: From Mail, tap ◀ Spider in the status bar.
Expected Result: Spider is in front. The main menu (not About) is expected — Mail is a separate app.

Title: Options - Contact Us opens support
Step: Open Options and tap Contact Us. Wi-Fi must be on.
Expected Result: You leave Options and a support page opens. What that page then loads can vary with the network.

Title: Options - Contact Us still leaves Options without internet
Step: Turn Airplane Mode on and turn Wi-Fi off. Open Options and tap Contact Us.
Expected Result: You leave Options. The support page may show a no-connection or failed-load screen instead of PeopleFun Support. That is the case — the redirect still happened.

Title: Relaunch - Same board after closing the app for a few seconds
Step: Start or resume a game and make one move (a card, or deal from the stock). Remember how the board looks.
Expected Result: The board has changed from the dealt position.

Title: Relaunch - Same board after closing the app for a few seconds
Step: Press Home first (the app saves when it goes to the background), swipe Spider away, wait about 3 seconds, and open it again. Do not kill it from the foreground without Home — that comes back on the menu.
Expected Result: You are on the game table with the same cards. A tap a card to start overlay is fine.

Title: Relaunch - Same board after closing the app for 35 seconds
Step: On a game you have already moved, press Home, swipe Spider away, wait about 35 seconds, and open it again.
Expected Result: You are on the same board as before the kill. This is a second wait, not a repeat of the short one.
